name: H.G. Infra Engineering Ltd
about: H.G. Infra Engineering Limited (HGIEL) is an Indian Road Infrastructure Company engaged in the business of Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Services, Maintenance of roads, bridges, flyovers and other infrastructure contract works. [1]
keyPoints:
Service Offerings
The company specializes in road construction through its EPC business, with a selective focus on HAM projects. It has diversified into railways, metro, solar power, and water projects. It has completed 10+ HAM projects and is executing 26 projects across 13 states in India, supported by a fleet of 3,000+ modern equipment. [1] [2]

pros: Company's median sales growth is 23.2% of last 10 years
cons: Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
